'''Field of Legend''' was a historical site on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], where many bloody battles were fought. It was located next to the [[Citadel (Gamorr)|Citadel]]. During the [[Rise of the Empire era]], a podracing course went through this field, as well as the Citadel.
